meta.name: InWonder
meta.description:
Shows about the worlds of science, technology and knowledge. Prepare to be taken on a factual adventure!

Shows: Exceptional Engineering S1 - "Harvesting Giants", Exceptional Engineering S1 - "Emergency Helicopter", Dictators' Hideouts S1 - "Stalin's Atomic Bunker", Orphans of the Wild S1 - "New Beginning’s and Sad Endings", Xploration Earth 2050 S2 - "Transforming How Things Are Made"
Available on: Samsung TV Plus, Plex
